title: PolySaaS public sysvars (Parameter in public schema)
description: Stored in parameters.Parameter.param_kwargs_json for rows reserved for platform sysvars (public only). Parameter.param1..param10 may mirror the first up to 10 env entries for tooling and atomic-service compatibility; slot_keys defines the env var name for each slot index 0..9.

service.description: Logical target (e.g. Render service name, internal slug).

notes.description: Operator-only context; not for end users.

slot_keys.description: Optional. Length N <= 10: slot_keys[i] is the env var name whose value is mirrored to Parameter.param(i+1) for that row.

env.description: ENV_VAR_NAME -> string value. Most bundled web services fit within 10 keys per row; overflow may use a second Parameter row with the same service and sequence+1.
